bio: Tightly-packed tables, a scattering of wine bottles and an appetising lineup of dishes with a seafood slant to share set the scene in this buzzy, modern, almost quirky bistro. Bar Misera is THE place to go for a casual meal with the mates in Antwerp’s hip Nieuw Zuid district. Kick off your meal with a few nibbles from the wide-ranging array of snacks on offer, like egg mayonnaise or sardines, before moving onto larger portions. First-class quality and flawless freshness are paired with acidic tangy notes. Think seabass, seared to perfection in its skin, flanked by sea lavender and a herby butter and then coated in a subtle fresh foamy sauce. Diners choose their own sides. An amusing concept, underpinned by a stellar wine cellar....
